questions.answer: Blueprints are mini-apps grouped by resource with url_prefix, registered on the main app to split files. Factory `def create_app()` builds the app in a function for fresh test instances and env-specific config.

questions.answer: Because the client did not send Content-Type: application/json, so get_json() returns None and `data['name']` raises TypeError. Fix: check `if not data` and return 400.
